svg.title: Nursing assistant — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as nursing assistant, wearing a care tunic. Visible work cue: A blood-pressure cuff connects through an open hose to a round pressure gauge with a single needle. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face.
